one_liner: An AWS SecOps agent deployed into each client's own AWS account that discovers all resources, runs read-only security checks, ranks findings by risk, and shows a posture dashboard with Bedrock-generated explanations.

delivery_model.how: We take this repo and deploy it directly into the client's AWS account (their EKS). The agent runs 24/7 inside their account.
delivery_model.access: Client has full admin. We get temporary deploy access via what PREREQUISITES.md lists. After deploy it is their account; we do not retain access.
delivery_model.safety: READ-ONLY and recommend-only. Never changes, deletes, or remediates anything in AWS.

language_decision.primary: Pure Go (single static binary, k8s-native, small image).
language_decision.no_python: No Python anywhere. The 'ML/AI' layer is Amazon Bedrock (a hosted API) called via the Go SDK, so no local ML runtime is needed.

dropped: The old CodeSentinel file scanner (Semgrep/Gitleaks/Trivy) is NOT part of this product.
GuardDuty, Security Hub, Inspector are NOT used (trial-only, then paid). Rely on free read-only AWS APIs + open-source Prowler.

architecture.internal/types: Core domain types (Resource, Finding, RiskFactors, PostureReview, Explanation).
architecture.internal/discovery: MULTI-REGION read-only inventory (E2/B3). EnabledRegions() via ec2:DescribeRegions; Inventory() runs regional services (ec2,lambda,rds,dynamodb,eks) concurrently per region + global services (iam, s3 with per-bucket region) once. Each resource carries its Region.
architecture.internal/collectors: Read-only security checks. ownchecks.go (MULTI-REGION own checks: IAM no-MFA/admin [global], S3 public/encryption [global], EC2 SG 0.0.0.0/0 + EBS encryption, EKS public endpoint, RDS public/unencrypted, Lambda public URL, DynamoDB encryption, CloudTrail multi-region; WithRegions + WithFilter(service,resource) for scoped audits) + prowler.go (ingests Prowler OCSF JSON) + scoutsuite.go + cloudsplaining.go (ingest their JSON behind the same Finding model). Tests: prowler_test.go.
architecture.internal/store: Persistence (E1). Store interface + Memory (fallback) + Dynamo (table CodeSentinal.-reviews, pk/sk schema, list newest-first). store_test.go passing.
architecture.internal/auth: Single-role superadmin auth gate (B1/E4). Password -> bearer token (in-memory, 12h TTL), Middleware protects /api except health+login+auth/status. Open if no password (dev, logs warning).
architecture.internal/api: HTTP API (v1). Auth: POST /api/v1/auth/login, GET /auth/status. Reviews: POST /review (full, persists latest), GET /review/latest, GET /reviews (history). Portal: GET /services (landing+counts), GET /regions, GET /resources?service=&region= (region filter), GET /resource?id= (resource audit page). On-demand: POST /audit?service=&resource= (RunAudit merges scoped findings into latest WITHOUT wiping other scopes). POST /explain?review=&finding=. GET /integrations (GuardDuty/SecurityHub/Inspector as disabled toggles, B6). Gate middleware + CORS.
architecture.dashboard/: React (Vite) SPA, hash-router. views/Login.jsx (superadmin gate), Services.jsx (B2 service cards + full audit), ServicePage.jsx (B3 resources table + region filter + audit), ResourcePage.jsx (B4/B5 security view + Audit button + explain drawer), Integrations.jsx (B6 disabled toggles). api.js carries bearer token. Served by unprivileged Nginx.
Helm chart — MICROSERVICES: backend.yaml (Go agent Deployment+Service, IRSA, pullPolicy Always), frontend.yaml (React/Nginx Deployment+Service, unprivileged nginx uid101 + writable emptyDirs for conf/cache/run/tmp), prowler-cronjob.yaml (Prowler CronJob, runAsUser 1000, entrypoint takes args — NO command override), prowler-install-job.yaml (post-install hook), prowler-pvc.yaml (shared EBS PVC gp2 RWO), ingress.yaml (ALB: / -> frontend, /api+/health -> backend), serviceaccount.yaml (IRSA SA shared by backend+prowler), _helpers.tpl, NOTES.txt, values.yaml.

gotchas_learned: image tag 'latest' + pullPolicy IfNotPresent = node keeps stale image; MUST use pullPolicy Always for mutable latest (fixed in values.yaml).

toniblyx/prowler ENTRYPOINT is /home/prowler/.venv/bin/prowler (not on PATH) and USER is non-numeric 'prowler' -> do NOT override command, pass args only, and set runAsUser:1000 so runAsNonRoot can verify.
nginx:alpine runs as root (fails runAsNonRoot) -> use nginxinc/nginx-unprivileged (uid 101) + emptyDir mounts on /etc/nginx/conf.d,/var/cache/nginx,/run,/tmp (pid file is /run/nginx.pid).
Prowler OCSF file can be concatenated arrays across runs -> collector uses a streaming json.Decoder.
gp2 storageclass needs the EBS CSI driver in k8s 1.37 (in-tree provisioner gone).
